prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1322; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion, and difficulty with overhead activity. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is one we would expect from a collision of this type. Over the course of 13 visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory, including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication, with visit frequency decreasing as function returned. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. The patient also reports a remote minor strain to the same area in the past, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not account for the current findings. Billed services correspond to the treatment rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Patient is improving and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home program adherence.
